_about: Short messages other pilots leave on Memorial Wall records (MemorialWall). When a record is made, the Wall rolls its messages from these groups and saves them: stranger (anyone), squadmate (a living member of the pilot's squad), entity_loss (anyone, when an Entity killed the pilot), rival (the killer, when it is an NPC Hunter or Rat: short and cold, never cruel) and anonymous (for an Unidentified pilot). {name} becomes the pilot's callsign. Netizen voice: lower case, abbreviations, typos. These are placeholder lines for Yosqi to rewrite. No lore.
